name: Creationism
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator who brought the heavens and the earth into existence at the beginning of time (Genesis 1:1). He intentionally fashioned humanity in His own image, granting mankind authority over all living creatures on earth (Genesis 1:26). Furthermore, God’s intimate involvement in human life is demonstrated by His personal care even before birth, as He forms each person within the womb (Psalms 139:13). This affirms a Christ-centered understanding of creation as purposeful, personal, and divine.
